title: Verify: Drawer and modal store unit tests
summary: Unit tests for drawer and modal actions
description: Write unit tests that import the real useUiStore and assert drawer and modal state changes. Nothing from the store is mocked.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reset store, when toggleDrawer is called twice, then drawerOpen is true then false
Given a reset store, when openModal('contribution') then closeModal are called, then modal is 'contribution' then null

steps.action: Import { useUiStore } from '../src/store/uiStore'. In beforeEach call useUiStore.setState(useUiStore.getInitialState(), true). Add test 'starts closed' asserting drawerOpen false and modal null. Add 'toggleDrawer flips' calling getState().toggleDrawer() twice and asserting true then false. Add 'openModal and closeModal' asserting modal 'contribution' then null.
